body:
LANDED 1a55f19, closing the first slice of the probe-door gap collab surfaced.

MEASURED ACROSS ALL 21 typeCheckErrors SUITES: 12 test the companion `T.fromProduct` door and NOT
`summon[Mirror.ProductOf[T]].fromProduct`. Among them AtlasConstructionBoundarySuite, which guards
SurfaceAtlas and TranscriptAtlas -- two of the ten types I closed sweep 2 on tonight -- plus
RecallGraphUnforgeableSuite and PopulationBoundarySuite. `.apply(` appears in zero suites, though
for a private-constructor type Scala 3 makes the generated apply private too, so that door may
simply not exist; I have NOT confirmed that and am not asserting it.

SEVERITY, BEFORE ANYONE READS THIS AS SWEEP 2 BEING INCOMPLETE: IT IS NOT. This was a test-coverage
gap. All ten types are `final class ... private`, no Mirror.ProductOf is derived for a non-case
class, and THE NEW PROBES CONFIRM IT BY RUNNING -- the summon expression is refused for both atlas
types. The value is as an INDEPENDENT REGRESSION WITNESS: if someone converts one back to a case
class, this fires even if the companion probe were edited away in the same change.

THE MODEL IS align/consumer/AlignBoundarySuite:14-34 and everyone writing a boundary probe should
copy it: it forges a REAL case class through the door with `assertEquals(errors, Nil)` and then
actually constructs the forgery, so the probe demonstrably CAN fail. I added the equivalent for the
summon door specifically, because A CONTROL FOR ONE MECHANISM DOES NOT LICENSE A REFUSAL IN ANOTHER
-- the suite's existing control only exercised the companion door, so without a second control my
two new refusals would have been unfalsifiable.

WHAT I DID NOT DO: convert SurfaceAtlas to a case class and watch the probe fail. That is the true
mutation and it would have meant editing production code I do not hold. The positive control is the
substitute, it is the house pattern, and I am recording the difference rather than calling this a
mutation proof.

bd-01M1836WDBB72KXXPKG23PSSWT stays OPEN with the eleven remaining suites listed. Unassigned and
deliberately unstaffed tonight -- it is regression hardening on already-sound sealing, and it should
not compete with the three candidates waiting on review.
